verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents ongoing monitoring with per-customer monitor/unmonitor configuration and status endpoints. Risk alerts raised during ongoing monitoring flow into case management, where ops can filter, prioritise and decide on them via the UI or API, and a dedicated Customer Screening and Ongoing Monitoring agent is described. missing for 10: explicit documentation that re-screening is triggered by watchlist/list updates (cadence or mechanism), a documented webhook event type specific to monitoring-generated alerts, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, screening is not one-shot — previously verified users are continuously re-screened against watchlist updates, and changes raise events I can act on

citations.quote: Its case management solution allows you to prioritise and review risk alerts raised during onboarding and ongoing monitoring.
This endpoint allows you to set the monitoring configuration for a single customer.
Customer Screening and Ongoing Monitoring agent
They can then select a case decision of ‘no risk detected’, ‘risk detected- accepted’ and ‘risk detected- offboard’.
Cases, alerts and risks can be reviewed and remediated either via the ComplyAdvantage Mesh web application or by integrating with the API for use in your own case management system.
